name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, repairing engines in his father's Lima taxi fleet. His knack for diagnosing and fixing complex mechanical issues quickly became apparent. He honed his skills through rigorous self-study and later earned a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in combustion engines. After a brief stint with a local racing team in Peru, he sought opportunities abroad, eventually landing a role as a junior engineer with a European Formula team.

Ricardo's analytical approach to engineering, coupled with his hands-on experience, makes him a valuable asset. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative environment where every idea is considered. His focus is always on finding marginal gains and optimizing every aspect of the car's performance. What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into actionable instructions that the pit crew can execute flawlessly.

Since joining Hendrick Motorsports, Ricardo has become a key element in the team. He is known for his calm demeanor and level-headed problem solving, even under extreme pressure. He is always looking to improve the car, the team, and himself.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee throughout the day.
